candidate.effect: atomic status approved -> execution_claimed; exact retry same command+tuple no-op; revisions/rejections/new claims conflict thereafter
candidate.process: ProgramRolloverExecutionProcess: propose plan -> independently review -> independent exec approve -> StartTypeIIObservationPeriod -> pending at TypeIIPeriodOpeningAccepted -> complete only actual ObservationPeriodStarted exact pinned plan version/range/root; private durable proof refs; reject/failure never inferred success
candidate.oldEvent: ProgramNextPeriodCreated removed from selected business emissions and terminal acknowledgement stored privately

sourceRules: ProgramRollover currently allows revise while approved until period_created, so process-only claim races.
Start period validates current approved plan and emits accepted 202. TypeIIRangeProcess then acquires/applies/settles and ObservationPeriodStarted is target-owned terminal fact.
TypeIIPlan owner requires proposal, independent reviewer, separate executive approver; each exact plan version.

atomicity.instructions: Is the proposed aggregate execution claim sufficiently narrow and atomic to close the rollover revise-vs-execute race while preserving approval as a business fact?

criteria.adequate: Atomic expected-revision command pins exact approved version/hash; after claim revisions and second claim fail; transient process failure preserves claim for resume.
criteria.too_much_state: Aggregate should own process progress and all successor receipts.
criteria.insufficient: Claim guard or retry semantics are materially ambiguous.

terminal.instructions: Does the selected process terminal rule correctly distinguish target period admission from actual period start?

criteria.correct: 202 acceptance is pending; exact actual ObservationPeriodStarted is required for complete.
criteria.too_strict: Plan approval or accepted opening is enough even if start process later fails.

proof.instructions: Does the proposed terminal proof pin all values needed to rule out a different period, changed plan version, or unrelated operation?

criteria.true: Actual saved ObservationPeriodStarted and its exact native chain establish period owner, requested range, plan ID/version/content hash, operation root and calendar authorization.

revision.instructions: What should happen if the TypeIIPlan is revised after approval but before StartTypeIIObservationPeriod executes?

criteria.pinned_approved_exact: Start fails until the exact approved version is again current; process must not silently switch version, and rollover pin remains the named approved carry-forward plan/version.
criteria.allow_plan_revision: The process may adopt the latest plan version if IDs match.

claim_version.instructions: Should claim pin only rollover version/content hash or additionally require the accepted approved decision fact and approval identity/time?

criteria.pin_approval_tuple: Pin exact rollover version/hash plus actual approved decision actor/role/time or its native approval proof reference; verify approval belongs to same version.
